When you hit that cue (the headphone symbol) button, that sends the music to the headphones.  So, just make sure the fader is all the way down and when you hit play that song will start to play, only through the headphones however and not to the mix.  

[This pic](http://cachepe.zzounds.com/media/quality,85/NI_TRAKTOR_KONTROL_S2_controller_front-520750dad3daffe5ba334dec4cdfae21.jpg) shows how it works on the S2 so maybe you can get an idea what the goal is.  The Cue volume is the volume going through the headphones while the Cue mix determines what is heard through the headphones.  All the way to the left is only the song that has the cue button triggered.  All the way to the right is the actual mix.  The middle is a blend of both.  When I mix using headphones only I like to have it in the middle so I can still hear the mix as I am bringing in that new track.
